interventions.name: Tara Menon
actions: Manager to conduct a confidential 'stay interview' with Tara this week, focusing on her specific challenges, career aspirations, and what would significantly improve her daily experience and commitment to the team.
HR Partner to review Tara's recent performance feedback and current workload to identify any immediate stressors or imbalances, and proactively offer support resources.
Manager to facilitate a team debrief in Sales to address recent changes and openly discuss team morale, inviting anonymous feedback on areas for improvement.

org_level_recommendations: Initiate an immediate, comprehensive departmental review of the Sales team culture, leadership, and operational practices, given the high exit rate and negative sentiment.
Implement 'stay interview' training for all managers, focusing on active listening and actionable follow-up, starting with high-risk departments.
Analyze exit interview data for actionable themes beyond sentiment, focusing on common triggers for departure across all departments, and develop a plan to address top 3 recurring issues.
